# tryjinai.com

> tryjinai.com handles sales for Jin AI and is operated by Jin AI. Jin AI is an AI assistant for teams. It spots repetitive work in the email, calendar, chat, and files a team connects, prepares drafts such as meeting briefs, status updates, and replies, and learns from each approval, edit, or skip. It never sends anything without a person's approval. Customer data is not used to train AI models. The official site is https://jinai.md/.

## Pages

- [Try Jin AI | The AI That Does the Prep Work for Your Team](https://tryjinai.com/): Try Jin AI on one repetitive task. Jin spots work that keeps coming back, prepares it before it is needed, and learns from your team. See use cases by role and start a pilot.
- [Jin AI Pilot Program: Try It on One Team and One Task | tryjinai](https://tryjinai.com/pilot/): How a Jin AI pilot works: pick one repetitive task, connect the tools you already use, review what Jin prepares, and measure what changed together.

## Key facts

- Works with: Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar, Slack, Microsoft Teams
- Output: drafts for review (briefs, agendas, updates, replies)
- Admin controls: choose teams and tools; exclude folders, channels, labels, or teams
- Privacy: findings go to the employee, not their manager; no scoring or ranking of people; each company's data kept separate
- How to start: one team and one repetitive task (pilot)
- Demo and contact: https://jinai.md/ (hello@jinai.md)
